definition: Arithmetic mean of the absolute flexible-calibration-curve deviation from the identity line at equally spaced points on the declared prediction grid; every grid point receives equal weight
grid_definition: The grid spans the 0.01 and 0.99 empirical prediction quantiles for classification, or the 0.005 and 0.995 empirical prediction quantiles for regression, with the configured number of equally spaced points
weighting_measure: Uniform discrete weighting over the equally spaced prediction-grid points
